Source Bigg Boss 20 is one of the most loved shows, and it has a huge fan following in different parts of the country. Currently, Bigg Boss is in its seventh week. Gullu, Arishfa Khan, Love Gill, Uditi Singh, Aamrapali Dubey, Mary Kom, and Manish Goel are nominated for this week's elimination.
 Gullu, Arishfa Khan, Love Gill, Uditi Singh, and Aamrapali Dubey are in the safe zone with a majority of votes. Mary Kom and Manish Goel are in the danger zone with the least votes.
 It remains to be seen whether Mary Kom or Manish Goel will leave the house this weekend.
 It is worth mentioning that Salman Khan will not be hosting this weekend's episode; yes, he is skipping the show due to prior commitments. 
 Director Rohit Shetty will be filling in for Salman Khan to host the show this weekend.
